summary: Equip your team with essential skills to combat insider threats and corporate fraud. Join our comprehensive training course and safeguard your business today.
lede: Corporate fraud training helps compliance, risk, security and audit professionals identify and address insider threats. It covers behavioral indicators, fraud analysis using data analytics and forensic accounting, and the development of prevention frameworks, digital safeguards and internal controls. Learners also assess supply chain security, monitor performance and communicate risk to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for safeguarding organizational integrity and preventing internal threats.
modules: Understanding Insider Threats and Fraud Dynamics
Evaluating Upstream and Downstream Security Protocols
Setting Security Targets and Performance Monitoring
Integrating Fraud Prevention into Organizational Strategy
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of corporate security and risk management principles. Prior experience in compliance, auditing, or IT security is recommended.
